files.README.md:
# Torvale Energy - connection guide workspace

Customer-service reference guide. The guide consists of exactly the files in guide/; anything not covered there is referred to the connections desk.
files.guide/connection-process.md:
# Connection process

## Application

Application review takes 20 working days once the site plan is received.

## Site survey

The site survey is booked within 10 working days of a passed review.
files.guide/metering.md:
# Metering

## Import meter

The import unit charge is 0.1587 per kWh on the standard domestic tariff.

## Meter reads

Meter reads are taken quarterly; customers may submit their own readings monthly.
